title: #shorts "Feet = direct line to your nervous system. 📞"
description:
#fyp POV: You’ve been foam-rolling your legs for weeks, but you’re still stiff. 🏃‍♂️💨
​The secret? It’s not your muscles—it’s your nervous system. Your feet have 200,000+ nerve endings that act like a remote control for your whole body. If your feet are "off," your brain keeps your hamstrings "on" (tight) to protect you.
​The 3-Step Reset:
1️⃣ Lacrosse Ball Roll: Release the fascia tension.
2️⃣ Toe Yoga: Reconnect the brain-to-foot signal.
3️⃣ Toe Splay: Decompress from those narrow running shoes.
​Tag a runner who is always "tight"! 👟✨
​#RunnersRecovery #FootCore #NervousSystem #MarathonTraining
